les: Van die kus tot op die plato
kaps_punt: Hoogliggende en laagliggende plekke (hersien "seevlak" en "hoogte bo seevlak"); Kusvlakte, eskarp, plato (konsepte en ligging van verskynsels in Suid-Afrika)

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika grens aan die Atlantiese Oseaan in die weste en die Indiese Oseaan in die ooste.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' (coastline on the Atlantic to the west and the Indian Ocean to the east and south); Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief' (search summary).

items.bewering: Die see styg en sak elke dag met die gety.
items.bron: IHO TWLWG7 South African tides and water levels presentation (semi-diurnal pattern: two highs and two lows a day); tide tables for Durban, Atlantis and Betty's Bay all show two high and two low tides daily (tidesatlas.com, tidetime.org).

items.bewering: Seevlak is daarom die gemiddelde hoogte van die see se oppervlak, en ons meet hoogte van daar af.
items.bron: EBSCO Research Starters, 'Mean sea level' (average height of the ocean's surface, the reference for measuring elevation); encyclopedia.com 'Sea level' (averaged over all stages of the tide); Wikipedia 'Sea level' (heights above mean sea level are elevations relative to that datum). The 'daarom' link from the daily tide to taking an average is correct.

items.bewering: Hoogte bo seevlak sê hoeveel meter 'n plek hoër as seevlak lê.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Sea level' / EBSCO 'Mean sea level': elevation is the height of a point above the mean sea level datum; South Africa states elevations in metres (e.g. Highveld 1 500-2 100 m, Wikipedia 'Highveld').

items.bewering: Hoogliggende plekke lê ver bo seevlak, en laagliggende plekke lê naby seevlak.
items.blok: Hoog en laag op 'n fisiese kaart
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' ('a high Central Plateau surrounded by coastal lowlands'); standard sense of high-lying and low-lying land relative to the sea-level datum.

items.bewering: Op 'n fisiese kaart wys kleure hoe hoog die land is. Die sleutel van die kaart sê watter kleur by watter hoogte hoort.
items.blok: Hoog en laag op 'n fisiese kaart
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Hypsometric tints' (colour bands placed between contours to show elevation ranges); Esri ArcGIS blog, 'Hypsometric tinting' (the legend shows which colour stands for which elevation).

items.bewering: So 'n kaart wys dat die binneland meestal hoog lê. Die land styg dus van die kus na die binneland.
items.blok: Hoog en laag op 'n fisiese kaart
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' ('South Africa's landscape is dominated by a high Central Plateau surrounded by coastal lowlands', plateau rimmed by the Great Escarpment); Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief' (plateau covers the largest part of the country). 'Meestal' and the general rise from coast to interior hold; the rise is not uniform in the south, which the lesson's own last block acknowledges.

items.bewering: 'n Plato is wye en hoë land wat redelik gelyk is.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, encyclopedic entry 'Plateau' (a flat, elevated landform that rises sharply above the surrounding area on at least one side); EBSCO Research Starters, 'Plateau (geography)'.

items.bewering: Die binnelandse plato maak die grootste deel van Suid-Afrika se binneland uit.
items.bron: Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief' (a plateau covers the largest part of the country and dominates its topography); Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' (landscape dominated by the Central Plateau).

items.bewering: Die Hoëveld lê op hierdie plato in provinsies soos Gauteng, die Vrystaat en Mpumalanga.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Highveld' (the part of the plateau above about 1 500 m and below 2 100 m; Gauteng is its main urban area; it makes up almost all of Mpumalanga); Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' (the Highveld encompasses the entire Free State and an adjoining strip of the provinces north of it).

items.bewering: Aan sy rand loop die plato steil af na laer land toe. Daardie steil rand is die eskarp. Dit loop min of meer langs die kus, maar dit is nie oral 'n aaneenlopende rand nie.
items.blok: Die eskarp: die rand van die plato
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa' (the plateau's edge descends toward the oceans on three sides; the Orange River has eroded a broad valley through it in the west; in places it has eroded so far it 'may no longer be evident'; it is absent for about 450 km north of Tzaneen); Britannica, 'Drakensberg' (runs parallel to the south-eastern coast).

items.bewering: Die uKhahlamba-Drakensberg is deel van die eskarp.
items.blok: Die eskarp: die rand van die plato
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa' and 'Drakensberg' (the Drakensberg is the eastern and highest portion of the Great Escarpment, reaching about 3 482 m on the Lesotho-KwaZulu-Natal border); uKhahlamba is the isiZulu name for the KwaZulu-Natal Drakensberg.

items.bewering: Van onder af lyk die eskarp dikwels soos hoë berge met kranse.
items.blok: Die eskarp: die rand van die plato
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa': from below the Limpopo, Mpumalanga and Lesotho sections have 'a very high and rugged appearance, combining steep-sided blocks and pinnacles', and the Cape sections form 'a 400-800-metre-high mountain-like ridge', while the top is 'almost table-top flat'. The comparison maps correctly: it describes how the edge looks from below and does not claim the plateau is a range of separate peaks, and the preceding sentences already establish it as the plateau's edge.

items.bewering: Die kusvlakte is laer en gelyker land langs die see onder die eskarp. Dit is nie oral ewe breed nie. In die noorde van KwaZulu-Natal is dit breed, maar op baie ander plekke is dit smal.
items.bron: Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief' (little genuine coastal plain between the escarpment and the sea, except in northern KwaZulu-Natal where it reaches about 80 km wide, and parts of Western Cape); Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' (in KwaZulu-Natal the plain 'is extremely narrow in the south, widening in the northern part of the province'; 'the low-lying coastal zone is narrow for much of that distance').

items.bewering: In die suide lê daar ook bergreekse en die Karoo tussen die eskarp en die see.
items.bron: The mountain ranges are right: Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' (in the south and south-west the Cape Fold Mountains run parallel to the coast below the escarpment). The Karoo half is too broad: Wikipedia, 'Karoo' and 'Karoo National Park' state that the Great Escarpment divides the Karoo into the Upper Karoo on the plateau above it (about 1 200-1 500 m) and the Lower Karoo on the plains below (about 700-800 m); the Bo-Karoo around De Aar, Richmond, Victoria West and Colesberg is high plateau at roughly 1 100-1 400 m (BirdLife IBA factsheet, Platberg-Karoo; places.co.za, Bo-Karoo). Britannica places the Great Karoo basin between the escarpment and the Swartberg and the Little Karoo lies further south, so those parts do lie between the escarpment and the sea, but part of what is called the Karoo lies on top of the plateau.
items.regstelling: Narrow the quantifier, keep the subject: only part of the Karoo lies between the escarpment and the sea, e.g. 'In die suide lê daar ook bergreekse en 'n deel van die Karoo tussen die eskarp en die see.' As written, a learner will conclude the whole Karoo is low land below the plateau, while the Upper Karoo lies on the plateau above the escarpment.

items.bewering: Die Atlantiese Oseaan lê in die weste en die Indiese Oseaan in die ooste. ... die land styg van die kus na die binneland.
items.blok: Hoog en laag op 'n fisiese kaart (kaart)
items.bron: Same sources as the matching study-text items (Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa'; Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief'). The map instruction places the plateau, Highveld, escarpment with the uKhahlamba-Drakensberg, and an uneven coastal plain consistently with those sources; it does not mention the Karoo.

items.bewering: seevlak: Die gemiddelde hoogte van die see se oppervlak, waarvandaan hoogtes gemeet word.
items.bron: EBSCO Research Starters, 'Mean sea level'; encyclopedia.com, 'Sea level'.

items.bewering: hoogte bo seevlak: Hoeveel meter 'n plek hoër as seevlak lê.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Sea level' (elevation relative to the mean sea level datum).

items.bewering: hoogliggend: Wat ver bo seevlak lê, soos die binnelandse plato.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Highveld' (plateau at 1 500-2 100 m); Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' (high Central Plateau).

items.bewering: laagliggend: Wat naby seevlak lê, soos die kusvlakte langs die see.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' ('coastal lowlands', 'the low-lying coastal zone'); Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief'.

items.bewering: binnelandse plato: Die wye, hoë en redelik gelyke land in Suid-Afrika se binneland.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa' (the plateau top is 'almost table-top flat'); Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief'.

items.bewering: eskarp: Die steil rand waar die plato na laer land toe afloop.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Great Escarpment, Southern Africa'; Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa' (the plateau 'is rimmed by the Great Escarpment').

items.bewering: kusvlakte: Laer, gelyker land langs die see, onder die eskarp.
items.bron: Britannica, 'South Africa: Relief' (coastal plain between the escarpment and the sea); Wikipedia, 'Geography of South Africa'.

opsomming: Everything checks out except one sentence: the lesson says the Karoo lies between the escarpment and the sea, but the Upper Karoo lies on the plateau above the escarpment, so it should say that part of the Karoo lies there; the one superlative (the plateau makes up most of the interior) and the comparison of the escarpment to high mountains with cliffs both hold.
